question: Which of the following is referred to as 'Near Money'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Savings Deposits**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Near money** refers to financial assets that are not directly spendable as cash but can be quickly and easily converted into cash with minimal loss of value.
 
• **National savings deposits** are considered near money because they are highly liquid and can be withdrawn or converted into cash quickly when needed.
